units.function: Broad CLI tests for scoped company discovery, creation errors, import route/confirmation policy, portability preview/result rendering, entity/file selection and legacy Adapter defaults.
units.dependencyDirection: Imports company CLI pure helpers and command registration, mocks HTTP, and consumes the shared portability result type without running archive parsing, database apply or server authorization.
units.keyDataModels: Company portability manifest, include flags, collision/action plan, Agent hierarchy/config/permissions, skills/files, projects/workspaces, tasks/routines/comments, env-input declarations, selected files and Adapter overrides.
units.lifecycle: Resolves company scope, selects preview/apply routes, gates apply confirmation, renders plans/results, maps entity selections to files and assigns a default Adapter for legacy process Agents.
units.testAssessment: Focused Vitest passed 18/18. Scoped fallback, explicit preview/apply and selection semantics are valuable, but archive/path/signature limits, terminal sanitization, Secret/identity/responsibility rebinding, plan digest, transactional apply/rollback and real authorization are absent.
units.designRationale: Make whole-company templates inspectable and selectively portable across Paperclip instances while supporting legacy Agent definitions.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs safe managed-cloud/self-hosted organization templates and FDE industry packages that can be previewed, selectively applied and rebound to local humans, Connectors, data grants and policies.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the explicit manifest, dry-run plan, collision actions, entity/file selection and non-interactive --yes gate. Remove vendor-default mapping, require signed/digested bundles, bind preview to apply, sandbox archive paths/content, and force identity/Connector/Secret/permission/data/responsibility rebinding before activation.
units.responsibilityConflict: The manifest can carry Agent permissions and reporting lines but has no accountable human or responsibility/evidence contract; unconditional .paperclip.yaml inclusion and silent claude_local fallback introduce behavior outside explicit entity/runtime consent.
evidence: 2026-08-18 focused Vitest: 18 passed via existing local binary
